name: Bobo
canonical_visual_description: Bobo is a chubby, smiling honey-brown cartoon teddy bear with round fuzzy ears, big friendly sparkling eyes, wearing a cheerful sunny yellow neckerchief. Stylized 2D cartoon animation aesthetic, bright vibrant colors, clean outlines.

name: Luna
canonical_visual_description: Luna is a bright playful orange cartoon fox with soft creamy-white chest fur, large expressive inquisitive amber eyes, a sleek fluffy tail with a white tip, and a tiny teal-blue explorer vest. Stylized 2D cartoon animation aesthetic, bright vibrant colors, clean outlines.

name: Milo

Stylized 2D cartoon animation aesthetic, bright vibrant colors, clean outlines.
